versions.changelog:
0.6.1.0 - Guide by channel name: channels that iptv-org has not linked to any guide (e.g.
Belarus-1, Belarus-4 Gomel, Cartoon Classics) are linked to the unlinked channels of
epg.iptvx.one by name ("Belarus-1" = "Беларусь 1 HD"). Strict: only within Russia and the
former USSR or Russian-language feeds, only when the name is unique in the guide and in the
catalog, never for time-shifted copies or channels already linked by iptv-org. Option, on by
default.
0.6.0.0 - Sports broadcasts from any channel go to Sports: the title must name a sport or
competition and show the event itself (opponents with a dash, match, final, race, fight…),
with exclusions for reviews, news, studios, previews, documentaries; films, series and
cartoons never count. Option: live broadcasts only.
0.5.1.0 - т/с and д/с always go to Series (episode 1 when the text names no number, plus a
per-show programme id); м/ф and м/с go to Kids.
0.5.0.0 - Genre markers for Jellyfin's Live TV sections (Movies, Series, Sports, Kids,
News): derived from Russian title prefixes (х/ф, т/с, м/ф, м/с, д/с — removed from the
title), guide categories and the channel's category; series get an episode number when
the title or description names one.
0.4.1.0 - A channel variant without its own guide (e.g. "HD" when only "SD" has one)
uses the guide of another variant of the same channel; time-shifted variants excluded.
0.4.0.0 - Preferred languages setting (e.g. "ru, en"): channel name from the guide and
programme title/description are taken in the most preferred language available.
Channel descriptions with country, regions, languages and categories (Russian or English)
are written to the Live TV channels after each Jellyfin guide refresh.
0.3.1.0 - Russian channel names from the guide: when a guide file has a Russian
display-name for a channel, it replaces the iptv-org name (option, on by default).
0.3.0.0 - Guide without grabber servers: for channels whose guides.json entry names a
site that publishes one XMLTV file (epg.iptvx.one for Russia and neighbours, and a few
others), the plugin reads that file and maps site_id to the playlist channel itself.
Guide file limit raised to 500 MB.
0.2.4.0 - Clearing the guide cache also removes the old programmes from Jellyfin's
database (Jellyfin's own guide refresh reads the empty guide). Clearing no longer waits
for a running sync or guide build: it reports that one is running instead.
0.2.3.0 - "Clear guide cache" only clears; it no longer starts a guide rebuild.
0.2.2.0 - "Clear guide cache" button: removes the built guide, downloaded guide files and
Jellyfin's cached copy, then rebuilds the guide. After every guide update Jellyfin's
cached copy is dropped, so new programmes show up without the 1-hour delay.
0.2.1.0 - Country, region and language lists appear right after the catalog download,
before the stream check finishes.
0.2.0.0 - Stream check: every playlist channel is probed (playlist request only); a dead
stream is replaced by another stream of the same channel, channels without a working
stream are left out; results cached (working 20 h, dead 3 days). Country, region and
language filters in the settings page with channel counts and search. One channel per
line option (best working HD/SD/regional stream) and hiding of time-shifted versions
(+1, +2, HD +4). The guide follows the last built playlist and no longer re-reads the
whole catalog.
0.1.0.0 - First release: daily iptv-org catalog download (JSON API), category filter
with Russian names, adult channels off by default, one stream per channel and feed,
channel numbers grouped by category, optional category prefix in names, program guide
merged from several hosted guide files with fallback, one-click Live TV registration.

name: IPTV-org
description: Builds a Live TV playlist from the iptv-org catalog (https://github.com/iptv-org/iptv), filtered by category, and a program guide merged from the hosted guide files listed by iptv-org. Both are plain local files used by Jellyfin's built-in M3U tuner and XMLTV guide; one button adds them to Live TV.
overview: Live TV channels from iptv-org with category filters and a program guide
